paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Abba, Mo'ed Katan (12a); he, R. Zeira, and Abaye were sitting, Zevaḥim (5a). Berakhot (4a) gives Rav Yitzḥak son of Rav Idi as the alternate attribution [its first reading is Rav Yitzḥak bar Adda].
